searchText: hi guys can we have a quick discussion about removing old engine API tests in hive? Since Geth does not support the merge anymore, it cannot pass these tests anymore (`engine-*`) all tests start by waiting for terminal total difficulty to be reached can we remove this and start the test chain at the merge? I think there was only one simulator that contains these types of tests? But yes, sounds reasonable to me
